entities.name: Léon Say
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jean-Baptiste-Léon Say was a French banker, statesman and diplomat. One of the 19th-century's noted economists, he served as French Finance Minister from 1872 until 1883. He also served as an ambassador in London and with an interest in horticulture he presided over the National Horticultural Society of France.
